role.purpose: four step illustrations in one generation for consistency; sliced and vectorised

subject.summary: a 2 by 2 grid of four separate flat illustrations of one consistent set, equal cells with wide empty gutters

elements.what: a map pin over a small striped coffee field
a round coffee roaster drum with three beans in front
a kraft paper coffee bag with a folded top
a small delivery box with a leaf-shaped tag

composition.layout_note: four equal cells, one object centered in each cell, same size and same front view

style.line: uniform 1.5 px near-black lines at 320 px cell width

series.block: Flat vector illustration: simple geometric shapes with 14 px rounded corners, flat fills in light warm grey #E4DCCD and warm white #FBF8F2 with deep forest green #1F4D3A as the only accent, uniform 1.5 px lines in near black #1C1B18, smooth flat colour only, one light from the upper left, plain warm white background, generous empty space.
